dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product shows where a quantity stands in a known range — storage used, a battery's charge, a quota, a password's strength — apart from the progress of a task: the two look alike by default, but they mean different things, so the product can restyle one without the other.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a meter reads: the bar's thickness and the ring's size and stroke per size, the track color, the ends' shape, whether the indicator meets the track or stands a gap from it, that gap and the stop indicator, the indicator color of each status, and the motion of a change of value or of status. The dimensions, the track and the default indicator color follow the progress indicator's tokens, so the two match side by side.
rules: Use a meter for a quantity in a known range; a task under way is a progress indicator, and a value with no meaningful maximum is neither.
Always give it a label (the accessible name); use valueText when a percentage is not the natural reading ("12.4 GB of 15 GB").
The meter has no thresholds: the product decides the status from what the value means, and says it in words too (valueText or the text beside it) — the status changes the color only.
Every indicator color on track.color, and on the surface behind the meter, must stay distinguishable (3:1): the boundary between them is the value.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; to set the meter apart from the progress indicator, value these tokens rather than the progress indicator's.

thickness.$description: The bar's height, per size: the progress indicator's by default. The bar has no length of its own; it fills the inline size its layout gives it.

size.$description: The ring's square box, per size: the progress indicator's by default.

thickness.$description: The ring's stroke width, per size: the progress indicator's by default.

color.$description: The whole range, from min to max: the progress indicator's track by default.

shape.$description: The corner radius of the bar's ends and of the indicator's ends, clamped to half the thickness. The ring's caps are round unless this is sys.shape.corner.none.

separation.$description: How the indicator is told from the rest of its track. divider: the indicator is drawn on the track with no space between them. gap: track.gap of empty space is left between them. Follows the progress indicator's choice, and so the system's; an instance's separation prop overrides it. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

gap.$description: Under gap: empty space, measured along the track, between the end of the indicator and the rest of the track. Not drawn under divider.

size.$description: The diameter of the dot a bar draws at the track's end, in the indicator color of its status, to mark where the range ends; never drawn larger than the bar is thick, and not drawn while the indicator covers it at max. 0 draws none.

color.$description: The indicator of a meter whose status is default: the progress indicator's indicator color by default.
The indicator of a meter whose status is info: the status's own color, as the tag's info mark.
The indicator of a meter whose status is success: the status's own color, as the tag's success mark.
The indicator of a meter whose status is warning: the status's own color, as the tag's warning mark.
The indicator of a meter whose status is error: the status's own color, as the tag's error mark.

value-duration.$description: How long the indicator's end takes to move to a new value, and its color to change to a new status's.
